requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

643-1486-4231-5361--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Maskwood Nexus, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Auton Soldier. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Maskwood Nexus, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

529-3197-6965-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2511-3197-4153--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 5.

4067-5003-5686-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
4067-5003-5686-7848.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent
Repeat steps 4 and 5 until you have {4} or more available.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
4067-5003-5686-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card. If the permanent taps for more than {1}, there can be less graveyards with seven cards in them.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7804.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
2921-6972-7804.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Captain Kathryn Janeway.
When Captain Kathryn Janeway dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Captain Kathryn Janeway enters, it triggers, revealing the top card of your library, putting the card back on top of your library, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Kathryn Janeway.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1594-1621-6867-7183.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

104-6720-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-6720-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3967-4871-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3967-4871-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate Yahenni four times by sacrificing four Squirrels.
When the Squirrels die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve all Yahenni abilities.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

232-2499-5778-6867.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers twice and its offspring ability triggers twice due to Yarok.
Resolve both innate Priest of Urabrask triggers, adding six {R}.
Resolve the first offspring trigger, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask that is 1/1.
When the Priest of Urabrask token enters, it triggers twice, adding six {R}.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 for the remaining offspring trigger.
Cast Appa by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Appa enters, it triggers twice and its offspring ability triggers twice.
Resolve both innate Appa triggers, airbending the nontoken Priest of Urabrask.
Resolve the first offspring trigger, creating a token copy of Appa that is 1/1.
Put the Appa token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Appa token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, airbending nothing.
Resolve the second offspring trigger, creating a token copy of Appa that is 1/1.
Put the Appa token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Appa token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, airbending the nontoken Appa.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat steps 2 through 6 once.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat from step 8.
232-2499-5778-6867.notes: Once you have extra mana, other nonland permanents can be airbended using Appa and returned to the battlefield each loop as desired.

224-225-1362-1772.description:
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping any land you control.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm and Stone-Seeder Heirophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2092-2544-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying at most {1}{U} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

1796-1824-2530-4740.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1796-1824-2530-4740.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

1796-1824-2530-5061.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1796-1824-2530-5061.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Staff of the Death Magus triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

240-2438-5470-6633.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

562-5465-7070.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Warrior en-Kor.
The Warrior en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Warrior en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.
Repeat.

5231-7083-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and Baloth Prime trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Baloth Prime trigger, untapping it and creating a tapped 4/4 Beast creature token.
Repeat.

654-681-1315-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
654-681-1315-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-2842-3944-5220.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

339-677-1849-2034.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2919-4186-4321-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-4186-4321-6830.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1545-5641-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-5641-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1462-2034-2423-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Bounding Krasis.
When the Bounding Krasis token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Bounding Krasis token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1974-3372-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Quicksilver Gargantuan
1974-3372-5466.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Quicksilver Gargantuan by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Quicksilver Gargantuan into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Quicksilver Gargantuan's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Quicksilver Gargantuan's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Quicksilver Gargantuan's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Trade Caravan

1025-4948-6658.notablePrerequisites:
One of Trade Caravan or Estrid's Invocation has a currency counter on it.
You control a basic Island.
1025-4948-6658.description:
During your upkeep, Stasis, Trade Caravan and Estrid's Invocation trigger.
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stasis trigger, causing you to pay {U}.
Resolve the Trade Caravan and Estrid's Invocation triggers, putting a currency counter on each of them.
During an opponent's upkeep, activate either Trade Caravan or Estrid's Invocation by removing two currency counters from it, untapping a basic Island.
Repeat.

3602-5686--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one of the two persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
3602-5686--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a persist creature that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Bhaal trigger.
Resolve the Bhaal trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the remaining persist creature.
Resolve the sacrificed creature's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

56-443-789-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-443-789-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Magus of the Bridge and Gutter Grime trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-443-789-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

645-1267-5361-5686.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-5361-5686.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Auton Soldier
Repeat each turn.

966-3584-5195.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus enough mana to cast the other instant or sorcery
966-3584-5195.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one other instant or sorcery card in hand.
966-3584-5195.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Unsubstantiate by paying {1}{U}, targeting that spell.
Thousand-Year Storm and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Thousand-Year Storm trigger, copying Unsubstantiate once for each instant or sorcery you've cast before it this turn, with each copy targeting the original Unsubstantiate.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers for each copy made this way, creating that many Treasure tokens.
Resolve the first copy of Unsubstantiate, returning the original Unsubstantiate to your hand.
All remaining Unsubstantiate copies fizzle due to no longer having a legal target.
Holding priority, activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

38-2232-2687.notablePrerequisites: Your control at least six creatures.
38-2232-2687.description:
Cast Chancellor of the Forge by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}.
When Chancellor of the Forge enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Chancellor of the Forge trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Phyrexian Goblin creature tokens with haste equal to the number of creatures you control.
When the Phyrexian Goblins enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Chancellor of the Forge to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Cloudstone Curio triggers, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Skirk Prospector seven times by sacrificing seven Phyrexian Goblins, adding seven {R}.
Repeat.
If you control at least seven creatures when Chancellor of the Forge enters the battlefield, this combo will net infinite red mana.

1526-3724-4499-4918.notablePrerequisites:
Circle of Dreams Druid does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two other creatures.
An opponent cannot block and kill Lightning Runner.
1526-3724-4499-4918.description:
Declare Lightning Runner as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Aethertorch Renegade.
Aethertorch Renegade enters the battlefield, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Resolve the Lightning Runner ability from step 1, causing you to get {E}{E}, then pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control, and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
